drafted_from: tool row tool:read-a-camera-card-index in tools/connected-drives/tool-rows.json, read-data/camera-card-index.mjs and read-data/camera-card-index.json, test/camera-card-index.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the clips on my camera card, /Volumes/1TB SSD, as recording sessions." It runs tool:read-a-camera-card-index with path /Volumes/1TB SSD and hands back one seed per recording session: its words (pending), where it came from, and its clip list with times. Nothing on the card changes.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads the card's own index and changes nothing. The seeds it describes are kept as rows of the person's seeds table by workflow:keep-each-camera-session-as-a-seed.
instructions: 1. Run tool:list-connected-drives and copy the mount of the card, for example /Volumes/1TB SSD.
2. Say "Read the clips on my camera card, /Volumes/1TB SSD, as recording sessions"; the AI calls tools:run for tool:read-a-camera-card-index with that path.

3. Read sessions (each with id, words, came_from, media and at) and the counts: clips_in_range, clips_before_since (older than the since time in read-data/camera-card-index.json), sidecars_unreadable and sidecars_without_media.
4. The workflow keeps each session as one seed row; a session already kept (same id) is not kept again.
5. To change what counts as a session, edit session_gap_seconds in read-data/camera-card-index.json; to change the first date read, edit since.
